title: Insurance Coverage & Claims Medicaid Plan Appeal Arrival Percent by Days from Collection to Claim Receipt
content:
**Medicaid Managed Care Plan, Insurance Coverage & Claims — arrival percent on plan appeals.** A claim that reaches the Medicaid plan late after the service is valued at a reduced percent on the plan appeal.

The plan appeal's crossover percent follows the calendar days from the order's collection date to the date the claim reached the plan. The collection date is read from the patient's order under **Laboratory Test Orders** (the order the appealed claim bills); the date the claim reached the plan is the date of the claim's submission on the claim history.

| Calendar days from collection to the claim reaching the plan | Crossover percent |
|---|---|
| More than 90 (the crossover far days) | 85 percent (crossover far percent) |
| More than 30 (the crossover near days), not more than 90 | 95 percent (crossover near percent) |
| 30 or fewer | 100 percent |

Under the plan appeal, the disputed charges are multiplied by the crossover percent, divided by one hundred.

## Two sides of each threshold

- 91 days: 85 percent. 90 days: 95 percent.
- 31 days: 95 percent. 30 days: 100 percent.

## Hypothetical illustration

Collected on 5 January, claim reached the plan on 14 April of the same non-leap year: 99 calendar days, more than 90, so 85 percent. Disputed charges of 200.00 USD become 200.00 times 85, divided by one hundred, 170.00 USD.
